# Native tactical corpus fixture

Generated by Slither's actual `baseline-v2-qualification` CLI with:

```text
--seed-count 2 --steps 12 --workers 1 --cadence 0.06 --output NEW_REPORT --corpus-directory NEW_DIRECTORY
```

The native source identity is in `receipt.json` and the corpus manifest. All 14
physical fixtures and both Motion teacher modes contribute complete native
sequences, on x86_64 Windows MSVC with the recorded math backend. Each row joins
the delivered observation/action to a successfully completed physical step.
Held steps are absent. Each seed remains a separate training/validation identity.

The gzip files preserve the exact emitted bytes. Receipt and object hashes are
verified in tests. This small synthetic corpus tests ingestion and sequence
ownership, not trained-policy quality or performance. Regenerate only with an
explicit new producer identity; do not synthesize observations in Python.
